blocks.zh: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Apparently Unacceptable (but WAS) | 表面上不可接受（但其實可行）
blocks.en: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Apparently Unacceptable (but WAS)

blocks.zh: 繁體中文解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 為何「表面上不可接受」？
blocks.en: Why "apparently unacceptable"?

blocks.zh: 性荷爾蒙（sex hormone）在全球多個監管地區歷史上被要求使用專屬廠房（dedicated facility）。初步看來，將其引入現有多產品設施似乎明顯違規。然而，本場景的關鍵教訓是：透過嚴謹的風險評估流程，可以科學地論證共用設施是可行的。
blocks.en: Historically, regulators in many regions have required sex hormones to be made in a dedicated facility. At first glance, introducing one into an existing multi-product facility looks like a clear violation. The key lesson of this scenario, however, is that a rigorous risk assessment process can scientifically justify shared-facility manufacture.

blocks.zh: 情境要點
blocks.en: Key points of the scenario

blocks.zh: 新引入物質：性荷爾蒙 Agent H（極低 ADE = 0.001 mg/day）
blocks.en: New substance: sex hormone Agent H (very low ADE = 0.001 mg/day)

blocks.zh: 挑戰：部分國家法規歷史上要求專屬設施
blocks.en: Challenge: regulations in some countries have historically required dedicated facilities

blocks.zh: 策略：早期與監管機構非正式溝通 + FMEA + QRMP
blocks.en: Strategy: early informal discussion with the regulator + FMEA + QRMP

blocks.zh: 結論：透過適當管控措施，可在共用設施製造
blocks.en: Conclusion: with appropriate controls, manufacture in the shared facility is feasible

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規要求 vs. 科學論證
blocks.en: Analogy: regulatory requirement vs. scientific justification

blocks.zh: 就像駕駛人在不確定某條路段是否允許通行前，先主動詢問交通主管單位，而非直接行駛或放棄。提前與主管機關溝通、展示科學數據，是合規策略的核心。
blocks.en: It is like a driver who is unsure whether a road section is open to traffic: rather than driving in regardless or giving up, the driver first asks the traffic authority. Talking to the authority early and presenting scientific data is the heart of a compliance strategy.

blocks.zh: 監管溝通的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of regulatory communication

blocks.zh: 委員會在擁有足夠數據後，立即主動與監管機關進行非正式討論，並提交 QRMP 草稿。這種「先溝通、再行動」的策略，降低了後期審查風險，也展現了廠商的透明度與責任感。
blocks.en: As soon as the committee had sufficient data, it proactively held an informal discussion with the regulatory authority and submitted a draft QRMP. This "communicate first, then act" approach lowered the risk at the later review stage and demonstrated the company's transparency and sense of responsibility.

blocks.zh: 14.4 Scenario 3 — QRMP Overview | 品質風險管理計畫概述
blocks.en: 14.4 Scenario 3 — QRMP Overview

blocks.zh: QRMP 的作用
blocks.en: The role of the QRMP

blocks.zh: 品質風險管理計畫（QRMP）是一份整合性文件，將 ICH Q9 框架系統性地套用於特定設施或產品引入。它不只是風險評估報告，更是一份行動計畫，說明：
blocks.en: The Quality Risk Management Plan (QRMP) is an integrated document that systematically applies the ICH Q9 framework to a specific facility or product introduction. It is more than a risk assessment report; it is an action plan that sets out:

blocks.zh: 識別了哪些危害
blocks.en: Which hazards were identified

blocks.zh: 採用了哪些評估方法
blocks.en: Which assessment methods were used

blocks.zh: 實施了哪些控制措施
blocks.en: Which controls were implemented

blocks.zh: 如何監控與審查
blocks.en: How they are monitored and reviewed

blocks.zh: ADE 數值差異的意義
blocks.en: What the ADE differences mean

blocks.zh: 從表格可以清楚看出 Agent H（性荷爾蒙）的 ADE 遠低於其他化合物：
blocks.en: The table shows clearly that the ADE of Agent H (sex hormone) is far lower than that of the other compounds:

blocks.zh: Antacid A：50 mg/day（相對安全）
blocks.en: Antacid A: 50 mg/day (relatively safe)

blocks.zh: Agent H：0.001 mg/day（最低，高效價）
blocks.en: Agent H: 0.001 mg/day (lowest, highly potent)

blocks.zh: ADE = 0.001 mg/day = 1 µg/day，代表設備表面殘留量必須控制在極低水平。這是此情境「表面上不可接受」的核心原因。
blocks.en: ADE = 0.001 mg/day = 1 µg/day, which means residues on equipment surfaces must be controlled at an extremely low level. This is the core reason the scenario is "apparently unacceptable".

blocks.zh: ADE（可接受每日暴露量）定義
blocks.en: Definition of ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure)

blocks.zh: ADE 是每日接觸劑量的上限，低於此值預期不會對最敏感族群（包括患者、作業員）產生不良反應，且涵蓋終身暴露。它由合格毒理學家基於毒理數據推導，並包含適當的安全係數。
blocks.en: The ADE is the upper limit of daily exposure below which no adverse effect is expected in the most sensitive populations (including patients and operators), covering lifetime exposure. It is derived by a qualified toxicologist from toxicological data and includes appropriate safety factors.

blocks.zh: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Facility Description & Controls | 設施描述與管控措施
blocks.en: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Facility Description & Controls

blocks.zh: 單廊式設施（Single Corridor Facility）佈局
blocks.en: Single corridor facility layout

blocks.zh: 設施以單一走廊為主軸，各製程室由 MAL（物料氣閘）和 PAL（人員氣閘）隔離。此設計的優點：
blocks.en: The facility is organized around a single corridor, with each process room separated by a MAL (material airlock) and a PAL (personnel airlock). Advantages of this design:

blocks.zh: 壓力階梯（pressure cascade）可控制空氣流向
blocks.en: The pressure cascade controls the direction of airflow

blocks.zh: 氣閘的「淨化延遲」（dwell period）防止門開時的瞬間污染
blocks.en: The airlock "dwell period" prevents instantaneous contamination when a door is opened

blocks.zh: 走廊對製程室保持正壓，確保污染不會從走廊流入
blocks.en: The corridor is kept at positive pressure relative to the process rooms, so contamination cannot flow in from the corridor

blocks.zh: 封閉製程（Closed Processing）的核心邏輯
blocks.en: The core logic of closed processing

blocks.zh: 性荷爾蒙 ADE 僅 1 µg/day，若使用開放製程，微量揚塵即可能超標。解決方案是透過工程控制：
blocks.en: The ADE of the sex hormone is only 1 µg/day, so with open processing even a trace of dust could exceed the limit. The solution is engineering controls:

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）：取樣、稱重在隔離環境進行
blocks.en: Isolator: sampling and weighing are performed in an isolated environment

blocks.zh: SBV（裂蝶閥）：密封物料轉移，防止揚塵
blocks.en: SBV (split butterfly valve): sealed material transfer that prevents dust release

blocks.zh: RTP（快速轉移口）：樣品安全移轉至 QA 實驗室
blocks.en: RTP (rapid transfer port): safe transfer of samples to the QA laboratory

blocks.zh: 就地封閉清潔（CIP）：設備離開製程室前先清潔
blocks.en: Clean-in-place (CIP): equipment is cleaned before it leaves the process room

blocks.zh: 比喻：SBV 的作用
blocks.en: Analogy: what an SBV does

blocks.zh: Split Butterfly Valve（裂蝶閥）像一個「對接連接器」——兩半分別安裝在物料桶與設備接口，對接時同時打開，分離時各自密封，全程粉末不接觸外界空氣，大幅降低揚塵風險。
blocks.en: A split butterfly valve works like a "docking connector": one half is fitted to the material container and the other to the equipment port. They open together when docked and each seals when separated, so the powder never contacts the outside air, greatly reducing the risk of dust release.

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計的多重防護
blocks.en: Multiple layers of protection in the HVAC design

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統採用「直流式」（once-through，無再循環），這意味著：
blocks.en: The HVAC system is "once-through" (no recirculation), which means:

blocks.zh: 污染物不會被再循環風帶回其他區域
blocks.en: Contaminants cannot be carried by recirculated air to other areas

blocks.zh: 排氣通過 HEPA 過濾（粗效 + 高效，兩段保護）
blocks.en: Exhaust air passes through HEPA filtration (coarse + high-efficiency, two stages of protection)

blocks.zh: 氣閘淨化確保開門時的污染不進入走廊
blocks.en: Airlock purging ensures that contamination from opening a door does not enter the corridor

blocks.zh: 此設計使得「空氣傳播途徑」的風險透過多重屏障降至可接受水平。
blocks.en: With this design, the risk of the "airborne transfer" route is reduced to an acceptable level through multiple barriers.

blocks.zh: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Risk Assessment | 風險評估
blocks.en: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 四大交叉污染途徑
blocks.en: The four cross-contamination routes

blocks.zh: 混淆（Mix-up）：錯誤物料進入製程室（人為錯誤）
blocks.en: Mix-up: the wrong material enters a process room (human error)

blocks.zh: 殘留（Retention）：前批物料殘留於設備表面
blocks.en: Retention: material from the previous batch remains on equipment surfaces

blocks.zh: 機械轉移（Mechanical Transfer）：殘留物附著於人員、設備、物料表面帶出
blocks.en: Mechanical transfer: residue clings to personnel, equipment or material surfaces and is carried out

blocks.zh: 空氣傳播（Airborne Transfer）：微粒透過空氣系統傳播
blocks.en: Airborne transfer: particles travel through the air system

blocks.zh: 空氣傳播的「多道障礙」論證
blocks.en: The "multiple barrier" argument for airborne transfer

blocks.zh: ISPE 原文詳細列出空氣傳播必須跨越的每一個障礙：
blocks.en: The ISPE text lists in detail every barrier that airborne material must cross:

blocks.zh: 逃離製程（escape the process）
blocks.en: escape the process

blocks.zh: 逆低速氣流通過氣閘進入走廊
blocks.en: pass through an airlock against the low-velocity airflow into the corridor

blocks.zh: 在走廊中傳播
blocks.en: travel along the corridor

blocks.zh: 再次逆低速氣流進入另一氣閘
blocks.en: pass again against the low-velocity airflow into another airlock

blocks.zh: 進入另一製程室及製程
blocks.en: enter another process room and process

blocks.zh: 每一步都有物理屏障阻攔，整條路徑的機率極低。這種「多重障礙論證」（multiple barrier argument）是現代 GMP 風險評估的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: A physical barrier stops the material at every step, so the probability of the whole path occurring is extremely low. This "multiple barrier argument" is the core logic of modern GMP risk assessment.

blocks.zh: ADE 到清潔限度的推導
blocks.en: Deriving the cleaning limit from the ADE

blocks.zh: ADE（1 µg/day）是起點，再結合：
blocks.en: The ADE (1 µg/day) is the starting point, combined with:

blocks.zh: 接受患者的最大每日劑量
blocks.en: The maximum daily dose for the patient receiving the next product

blocks.zh: 設備產品接觸面積
blocks.en: The product-contact surface area of the equipment

blocks.zh: 批次大小
blocks.en: The batch size

blocks.zh: 計算出設備表面最大允許殘留量（µg/cm²），作為清潔驗證的接受標準。
blocks.en: These give the maximum allowable residue on equipment surfaces (µg/cm²), which serves as the acceptance criterion for cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: Surrogate Testing（替代物測試）
blocks.en: Surrogate testing

blocks.zh: 對於潛在有害物質（如性荷爾蒙），不能使用真實 API 進行清潔驗證的暴露測試。替代物（surrogate）應具有相似的物理化學特性（溶解度、黏附性），但毒性較低，可安全操作。
blocks.en: For potentially hazardous substances such as sex hormones, the real API cannot be used in exposure tests for cleaning validation. A surrogate should have similar physicochemical properties (solubility, adhesion) but lower toxicity, so that it can be handled safely.

blocks.zh: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Cleaning Review, FMEA & Risk Control | 清潔審查、FMEA 及風險控制
blocks.en: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Cleaning Review, FMEA & Risk Control

blocks.zh: Ppk（製程效能指標）解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting Ppk (process performance index)

blocks.zh: Ppk 衡量製程整體效能（包含製程平均值偏移）：
blocks.en: Ppk measures overall process performance (including shifts in the process mean):

blocks.zh: Ppk < 1.0：製程不穩定，超規風險高
blocks.en: Ppk < 1.0: the process is unstable and the risk of going out of specification is high

blocks.zh: Ppk = 0.34（改善前）：約 15,000 ppm 超標機率，不可接受
blocks.en: Ppk = 0.34 (before improvement): about 15,000 ppm probability of exceeding the limit, unacceptable

blocks.zh: Ppk = 2.01（DoE 後）：約 251 ppm，可接受（需加強監控）
blocks.en: Ppk = 2.01 (after DoE): about 251 ppm, acceptable (with enhanced monitoring)

blocks.zh: 工業標準：清潔驗證通常要求 Ppk ≥ 1.33
blocks.en: Industry standard: cleaning validation usually requires Ppk ≥ 1.33

blocks.zh: Scenario 3 的關鍵轉折點
blocks.en: The key turning point in Scenario 3

blocks.zh: 不同於 Scenario 2（混摻機無法達到要求，最終放棄引入），Scenario 3 中：
blocks.en: Unlike Scenario 2 (where the blender could not meet the requirement and the introduction was ultimately abandoned), in Scenario 3:

blocks.zh: DoE 成功改善清潔製程（Ppk 0.34 → 2.01）
blocks.en: DoE successfully improved the cleaning process (Ppk 0.34 → 2.01)

blocks.zh: 混摻桶（blending bin）改為專屬（dedicated），消除最高風險環節
blocks.en: The blending bin was made dedicated, eliminating the highest-risk step

blocks.zh: 其他所有管控措施共同論證風險可接受
blocks.en: All the other controls together justified the risk as acceptable

blocks.zh: 這正是「表面上不可接受，但實際上可行」的核心：工程措施加上科學數據，成功翻轉了初始的悲觀判斷。
blocks.en: This is the essence of "apparently unacceptable, but actually feasible": engineering measures combined with scientific data overturned the initial pessimistic judgment.

blocks.zh: 管控層級（Hierarchy of Controls）
blocks.en: Hierarchy of controls

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調選擇管控措施時應遵循優先順序（由高至低）：
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that controls should be selected in the following order of priority (highest to lowest):

blocks.zh: 消除（Elimination）：移除危害源
blocks.en: Elimination: remove the source of the hazard

blocks.zh: 替代（Substitution）：以低危害替代
blocks.en: Substitution: replace it with something less hazardous

blocks.zh: 工程控制（Engineering Controls）：隔離器、密閉轉移
blocks.en: Engineering controls: isolators, closed transfer

blocks.zh: 行政管控（Administrative Controls）：程序、訓練
blocks.en: Administrative controls: procedures, training

blocks.zh: 個人防護（PPE）：防護服
blocks.en: Personal protective equipment (PPE): protective clothing

blocks.zh: 本情境中，封閉製程（工程控制）是核心，程序和電子管制作為輔助。
blocks.en: In this scenario, closed processing (an engineering control) is the core, supported by procedures and electronic access control.

blocks.zh: 「Fail-Safe」設計原則
blocks.en: The "fail-safe" design principle

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調管控措施應設計為「fail safe」（失效安全）：當系統出現異常，應自動進入安全狀態（例如警報、鎖閉），而非依賴人員反應。電子門禁、HEPA 壓差警報均符合此原則。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically emphasizes that controls should be designed to "fail safe": when the system malfunctions, it should go automatically to a safe state (for example, an alarm or a lock-out) rather than depend on human reaction. Electronic door access control and HEPA differential pressure alarms both follow this principle.

blocks.zh: 六個月滾動審查的實踐意義
blocks.en: Why the six-month rolling review matters in practice

blocks.zh: 風險評估不是「做一次就完成」。定期審查、輪換委員（引入新視角）、結合操作人員的回饋，確保風險計畫與現實製程保持同步，這是 ICH Q9 持續改善精神的體現。
blocks.en: A risk assessment is not "done once and finished". Periodic review, rotation of committee members (bringing in fresh perspectives) and feedback from operators keep the risk plan in step with the real process. This reflects the continual improvement spirit of ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Summary | 總結
blocks.en: 14.4 Scenario 3 — Summary

blocks.zh: Scenario 3 的三大學習要點
blocks.en: Three key learning points from Scenario 3

blocks.zh: 避免過度保守決策：初始感覺「不可行」不等於真的不可行，需要數據支持。
blocks.en: Avoid over-conservative decisions: an initial feeling that something is "not feasible" does not mean it really is; data are needed.

blocks.zh: 工程控制優先：DoE 驅動清潔改善、封閉製程設計，讓高效價物質的共用生產成為可能。
blocks.en: Engineering controls first: DoE-driven cleaning improvement and closed process design made shared manufacture of a highly potent substance possible.

blocks.zh: 跨職能協作 + 監管早期溝通：降低後期審查風險，建立信任基礎。
blocks.en: Cross-functional collaboration + early regulatory communication: lowers the risk at later review and builds trust.

blocks.zh: 14.5 Scenario 4 — Existing Facility with Large Product Portfolio | 現有設施、大型產品組合
blocks.en: 14.5 Scenario 4 — Existing Facility with Large Product Portfolio

blocks.zh: Scenario 4 的複雜性
blocks.en: The complexity of Scenario 4

blocks.zh: 這是四個情境中規模最大、複雜度最高的。關鍵特點：
blocks.en: This is the largest and most complex of the four scenarios. Key features:

blocks.zh: 32 個產品、10 種 API — 清潔矩陣維度極大（10×10 = 100 種組合）
blocks.en: 32 products and 10 APIs: the cleaning matrix is very large (10×10 = 100 combinations)

blocks.zh: 完全開放製程（無工程控制）— 交叉污染風險相對高
blocks.en: Fully open processing (no engineering controls): relatively high cross-contamination risk

blocks.zh: 矩陣法清潔驗證 — 以最嚴格組合作為整體標準
blocks.en: Matrix approach to cleaning validation: the most stringent combination is used as the standard for the whole matrix

blocks.zh: 初始分析顯示不符合 EU GMP — 需要系統性重新審查
blocks.en: The initial analysis showed non-compliance with EU GMP: a systematic re-review was needed

blocks.zh: 比喻：矩陣法清潔驗證
blocks.en: Analogy: the matrix approach to cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 想像 10 種 API 兩兩排列，就像一個 10×10 的棋盤。矩陣法的概念是：不需要驗證每一格（100 種組合），而是找出最嚴苛的那一格（最低清潔限度），以此作為整體驗證標準——只要最難的一格通過，其餘自動滿足。
blocks.en: Imagine 10 APIs paired with each other like a 10×10 chessboard. The idea of the matrix approach is that you do not need to validate every square (100 combinations); you find the most demanding square (the lowest cleaning limit) and use it as the standard for the whole validation. If the hardest square passes, the rest are automatically satisfied.

blocks.zh: 14.5.1 Scenario 4 — Background: Product Portfolio | 產品組合背景資訊
blocks.en: 14.5.1 Scenario 4 — Background: Product Portfolio

blocks.zh: 開放製程的風險意涵
blocks.en: What open processing means for risk

blocks.zh: 「所有製程均為相當開放」（fairly open）意味著：無隔離器、無密閉轉移裝置、無工程控制。這對於 Anti-hypertensive1（ADE = 25 µg/day）和 Opioid（ADE = 50 µg/day）而言，是顯著的交叉污染風險因素。
blocks.en: "All processes are fairly open" means no isolators, no closed transfer devices and no engineering controls. For Anti-hypertensive1 (ADE = 25 µg/day) and the Opioid (ADE = 50 µg/day), this is a significant cross-contamination risk factor.

blocks.zh: 產品組合分析要點
blocks.en: Key points of the portfolio analysis

blocks.zh: 10 種 API 的 ADE 範圍跨越三個數量級：
blocks.en: The ADEs of the 10 APIs span three orders of magnitude:

blocks.zh: 清潔矩陣法（Matrix Approach）邏輯
blocks.en: Logic of the cleaning matrix approach

blocks.zh: 原始矩陣：所有組合中最低限度 = 0.1 µg/cm²（Anti-hypertensive1 → Anti-hypertensive2）。
blocks.en: In the original matrix, the lowest limit among all combinations = 0.1 µg/cm² (Anti-hypertensive1 → Anti-hypertensive2).

blocks.zh: 問題：EU GMP 第 3.6 節要求檢測方法能可靠偵測此限度，但原始 LOD 均高於 0.1 µg/cm²，不符合要求。
blocks.en: Problem: EU GMP Section 3.6 requires that the test method can reliably detect this limit, but all the original LODs were above 0.1 µg/cm², so the requirement was not met.

blocks.zh: 解決步驟：
blocks.en: Resolution steps:

blocks.zh: 改善分析方法（見 Table 14.7）
blocks.en: Improve the analytical methods (see Table 14.7)

blocks.zh: 新 LOD 仍無法偵測 0.1 µg/cm²（Anti-hypertensive1 新 LOD = 0.05）
blocks.en: The new LOD still cannot detect 0.1 µg/cm² (new LOD for Anti-hypertensive1 = 0.05)

blocks.zh: 將此組合（Anti-hypertensive1 → Anti-hypertensive2）從矩陣中「拉出」，改為每次化學分析確認
blocks.en: Take this combination (Anti-hypertensive1 → Anti-hypertensive2) out of the matrix and confirm it by chemical analysis each time

blocks.zh: 新矩陣整體限度提升至 2.0 µg/cm²，新 LOD 足以偵測
blocks.en: The overall limit of the new matrix rises to 2.0 µg/cm², and the new LOD is sufficient to detect it

blocks.zh: EU GMP Section 3.6 的要求
blocks.en: The requirement of EU GMP Section 3.6

blocks.zh: EU GMP 第 3.6 節規定，若毒理學評估所推導的殘留限度無法被已驗證的分析方法可靠偵測，則相關產品不得在共用設施製造。這是 Scenario 4 初始不合規的法規依據。
blocks.en: EU GMP Section 3.6 states that if the residue limit derived from the toxicological assessment cannot be reliably detected by a validated analytical method, the product concerned may not be manufactured in a shared facility. This is the regulatory basis for the initial non-compliance in Scenario 4.

blocks.zh: 14.5.2 Scenario 4 — Risk Assessment | 風險評估流程
blocks.en: 14.5.2 Scenario 4 — Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 風險評估的起點：法規符合性檢查
blocks.en: The starting point of the risk assessment: regulatory compliance check

blocks.zh: 邏輯圖的第一個問題就是：「是否有法規要求使用專屬設施？」在 Scenario 4 中，初始答案幾乎是「是」，因為檢測方法無法偵測最嚴格的清潔限度。這驅動了整個改善行動。
blocks.en: The first question in the logic diagram is: "Is there a regulatory requirement for a dedicated facility?" In Scenario 4 the initial answer was almost "yes", because the test method could not detect the most stringent cleaning limit. This drove the whole improvement effort.

blocks.zh: 分析方法改善的策略意義
blocks.en: Why improving the analytical method matters

blocks.zh: 提升 LOD（偵測下限）等同於提升對清潔有效性的「信心」。當 LOD 優於清潔限度，才能可靠地宣稱設備「清潔至符合標準」。若 LOD 高於清潔限度，則結果「合格」只代表「在方法偵測範圍內未發現問題」，科學意義不足。
blocks.en: Improving the LOD (limit of detection) is equivalent to improving "confidence" in cleaning effectiveness. Only when the LOD is better than the cleaning limit can equipment be reliably declared "clean to the standard". If the LOD is higher than the cleaning limit, a "pass" result only means "no problem was found within the detection range of the method", which has insufficient scientific meaning.

blocks.zh: 「拉出矩陣」的實務操作
blocks.en: Handling a combination "pulled out of the matrix"

blocks.zh: Anti-hypertensive1 → Anti-hypertensive2 被從矩陣拉出後，每次此序列發生時，需要：
blocks.en: Once Anti-hypertensive1 → Anti-hypertensive2 has been pulled out of the matrix, every time this sequence occurs the following is required:

blocks.zh: 在 Anti-hypertensive2 生產前執行棉棒取樣（swab sampling）
blocks.en: Swab sampling before Anti-hypertensive2 is produced

blocks.zh: 以化學分析確認殘留 < 0.1 µg/cm²
blocks.en: Chemical analysis to confirm that the residue is < 0.1 µg/cm²

blocks.zh: 合格後才能確認設備清潔並放行
blocks.en: Only after it passes can the equipment be confirmed clean and released

blocks.zh: 這是一種「排除後個別處理」（case-by-case）的管控策略，既滿足法規要求，又不需要完全改變矩陣法。
blocks.en: This is a case-by-case control strategy for excluded items; it meets the regulatory requirement without changing the matrix approach entirely.

blocks.zh: 歷史清潔數據的解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting historical cleaning data

blocks.zh: 30 次清潔中有 1 次失敗（3.3%），根本原因是「未遵照程序」（human error），而非清潔製程本身失效。這是重要區別——製程能力本身沒問題，問題在行為。CAPA 選擇加強訓練（而非改變製程），具有針對性。
blocks.en: One failure in 30 cleanings (3.3%) was caused by "failure to follow the procedure" (human error), not by failure of the cleaning process itself. This is an important distinction: the process capability is sound and the problem lies in behavior. The CAPA chose to reinforce training (rather than change the process), which is well targeted.

blocks.zh: 最差情況選擇的邏輯
blocks.en: The logic of worst-case selection

blocks.zh: Opioid 被選為最差情況（worst case），而非 Anti-hypertensive1（ADE 更低 = 25 vs 50 µg/day）。原因：
blocks.en: The Opioid was chosen as the worst case rather than Anti-hypertensive1, even though the latter has the lower ADE (25 vs 50 µg/day). The reasons:

blocks.zh: Anti-hypertensive1 批次數少（36/年）、批量小（7 kg）
blocks.en: Anti-hypertensive1 has few batches (36/year) and a small batch size (7 kg)

blocks.zh: Opioid 批次頻繁（79/年）、批量中等（115 kg），接觸面積大
blocks.en: The Opioid has frequent batches (79/year), a medium batch size (115 kg) and a large contact surface area

blocks.zh: Opioid 使用 Process 2，涵蓋設施中所有製程步驟
blocks.en: The Opioid uses Process 2, which covers all the process steps in the facility

blocks.zh: 風險 = 危害（ADE 低）× 暴露（頻率高、接觸面積大）。單純以 ADE 排名並不足夠。
blocks.en: Risk = hazard (low ADE) × exposure (high frequency, large contact area). Ranking by ADE alone is not enough.

blocks.zh: 「最差情況」與清潔驗證的「最差情況」不同
blocks.en: The "worst case" here differs from the "worst case" in cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 原文特別說明：用於交叉污染風險評估的最差情況（opioid）不等同於清潔驗證的最差情況。
blocks.en: The source text specifically explains that the worst case used for cross-contamination risk assessment (the opioid) is not the same as the worst case for cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 交叉污染 worst case：考量危害性 + 製程暴露頻率 + 接觸面積
blocks.en: Cross-contamination worst case: considers hazard + process exposure frequency + contact surface area

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證 worst case：通常選擇最難清潔的物質（cleanability rank 最高）
blocks.en: Cleaning validation worst case: usually the substance that is hardest to clean (highest cleanability rank)

blocks.zh: 「涵蓋所有製程步驟」的意義
blocks.en: What "covers all process steps" means

blocks.zh: 選擇 Opioid（Process 2，10 步）作為風險評估對象，並非因為它是最危險的，而是因為它的製程涵蓋設施中所有製程步驟。一次評估即可代表所有產品的製程節點，避免重複工作。
blocks.en: The Opioid (Process 2, 10 steps) was chosen for the risk assessment not because it is the most dangerous but because its process covers every process step in the facility. A single assessment can therefore represent the process nodes of all products and avoid duplicated work.

blocks.zh: 14.5.2.1 Scenario 4 — Fishbone & FMEA Analysis | 魚骨圖與 FMEA 分析
blocks.en: 14.5.2.1 Scenario 4 — Fishbone & FMEA Analysis

blocks.zh: RPN（風險優先係數）計算與閾值
blocks.en: RPN (risk priority number) calculation and thresholds

blocks.zh: RPN = 嚴重度（S）× 發生率（O）× 偵測性（D）
blocks.en: RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detectability (D)

blocks.zh: RPN < 125：可接受風險，無需立即行動
blocks.en: RPN < 125: acceptable risk, no immediate action required

blocks.zh: 125 ≤ RPN ≤ 343：應實施風險降低措施（可繼續生產）
blocks.en: 125 ≤ RPN ≤ 343: risk reduction measures should be implemented (production may continue)

blocks.zh: RPN > 343：不可接受風險，須停止生產直到降低風險
blocks.en: RPN > 343: unacceptable risk, production must stop until the risk is reduced

blocks.zh: 高 RPN 項目分析
blocks.en: Analysis of the high-RPN items

blocks.zh: RPN = 700（最高）：出現兩次，均為「設備未清潔（視覺檢查不足）」
blocks.en: RPN = 700 (highest): appears twice, both for "equipment not clean (visual inspection not adequate)"

blocks.zh: 嚴重度 10（患者暴露）× 發生率 7（視覺常常無法發現）× 偵測性 10（無化學分析）= 700
blocks.en: Severity 10 (patient exposure) × occurrence 7 (visual inspection often fails to find it) × detectability 10 (no chemical analysis) = 700

blocks.zh: 核心問題：僅靠視覺檢查無法可靠確認設備清潔到 0.1 µg/cm² 水平
blocks.en: The core problem: visual inspection alone cannot reliably confirm that equipment is clean to the 0.1 µg/cm² level

blocks.zh: RPN = 490 和 350：機械轉移問題（著裝未更換、設備帶殘留）
blocks.en: RPN = 490 and 350: mechanical transfer problems (gowning not changed, equipment carrying residue)

blocks.zh: 關鍵發現：最高風險來自「制度性缺陷」（視覺清潔驗證不足、著裝程序不完善），而非設施設計。
blocks.en: Key finding: the highest risks come from "systemic weaknesses" (inadequate visual cleaning verification, incomplete gowning procedures) rather than from facility design.

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Fishbone Analysis）的用途
blocks.en: Purpose of the fishbone analysis

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Ishikawa diagram）是 FMEA 的前置工具，用來系統性地腦力激盪四種交叉污染模式的所有可能原因（人員、方法、設備、環境、材料、量測）。完成魚骨圖後，再進行正式的 FMEA 表格分析，確保不遺漏任何失效模式。
blocks.en: The fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram is a preparatory tool for FMEA, used to brainstorm systematically all possible causes of the four cross-contamination modes (people, methods, equipment, environment, materials, measurement). Once the fishbone is complete, the formal FMEA table analysis follows, ensuring that no failure mode is missed.

blocks.zh: 「偵測性 = 10」的意義
blocks.en: What "detectability = 10" means

blocks.zh: 偵測性評分為 10 代表「幾乎無法偵測」——現有管控完全無法發現此問題。在「Equipment not clean / Visual not adequate」這一行，視覺檢查無法偵測微量殘留，故 D = 10，直接讓 RPN 爆錶。這說明了為何化學分析（swab testing）是不可缺少的清潔驗證手段。
blocks.en: A detectability score of 10 means "almost impossible to detect": the existing controls cannot find the problem at all. In the row "Equipment not clean / Visual not adequate", visual inspection cannot detect trace residue, so D = 10, which sends the RPN off the scale. This shows why chemical analysis (swab testing) is an indispensable means of cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 14.5.2 Scenario 4 — Risk Evaluation, Control & Communication | 風險評價、控制與溝通
blocks.en: 14.5.2 Scenario 4 — Risk Evaluation, Control & Communication

blocks.zh: 四大「必須停工」項目的實務意涵
blocks.en: Practical meaning of the four "must stop production" items

blocks.zh: 走廊暫存（staging in corridor）：材料和設備在走廊中混合暫放，極易導致不同 API 的物料混淆。改善：禁止走廊暫存，所有物料直接進出製程室。
blocks.en: Staging in the corridor: materials and equipment are staged together in the corridor, which easily leads to mix-up of materials from different APIs. Remedy: prohibit corridor staging, so that all materials go directly into and out of the process rooms.

blocks.zh: 視覺清潔驗證不足：對 ADE 低的 API（如 Anti-hypertensive1），肉眼無法確認清潔至 0.1 µg/cm²。改善：引入棉棒取樣化學分析。
blocks.en: Inadequate visual cleaning verification: for an API with a low ADE (such as Anti-hypertensive1), the naked eye cannot confirm cleaning to 0.1 µg/cm². Remedy: introduce swab sampling with chemical analysis.

blocks.zh: 更換 API 時未更換著裝：操作人員從一個 API 製程區移至另一個時，若不更換防護服，會機械性地攜帶殘留物。改善：制定強制換裝程序。
blocks.en: Gowning not changed when changing API: if operators moving from one API process area to another do not change their protective clothing, they mechanically carry residue with them. Remedy: establish a mandatory gown-change procedure.

blocks.zh: 設備殘留帶出製程室：設備移出前未充分清潔，導致殘留物散播至走廊和其他製程室。改善：設備離室前必須清潔驗收。
blocks.en: Equipment residue carried out of the process room: equipment removed before adequate cleaning spreads residue to the corridor and other process rooms. Remedy: equipment must be cleaned and accepted before it leaves the room.

blocks.zh: 風險溝通的三個層次
blocks.en: Three levels of risk communication

blocks.zh: 即時通報：不可接受風險 → 立即通知高管
blocks.en: Immediate notification: unacceptable risk, so notify senior management at once

blocks.zh: 定期更新：每週更新直到風險降至可接受水平
blocks.en: Regular updates: weekly updates until the risk is reduced to an acceptable level

blocks.zh: 系統性管理：CAPA 管理所有改善行動；Change Control 確保評估持續有效
blocks.en: Systematic management: CAPA manages all improvement actions; change control ensures the assessment remains valid

blocks.zh: 觸發重新審查的四種情況
blocks.en: Four triggers for re-review

blocks.zh: 風險評估不是靜態文件，以下任何情況均需重新評估：
blocks.en: A risk assessment is not a static document; any of the following requires re-assessment:

blocks.zh: 產品組合變動（新增/移除）
blocks.en: A change in the product portfolio (additions/removals)

blocks.zh: 設施、設備或製程變更
blocks.en: A change to the facility, equipment or process

blocks.zh: 產品特性變化（MDD、ADE 修訂）
blocks.en: A change in product characteristics (MDD, ADE revision)

blocks.zh: 定期年度審查（最低頻率）
blocks.en: Periodic annual review (the minimum frequency)

blocks.zh: 這與 ICH Q10「持續改善」精神一致，也是法規（EU GMP、FDA）對品質系統的基本要求。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the "continual improvement" spirit of ICH Q10 and is also a basic regulatory expectation (EU GMP, FDA) for the quality system.

blocks.zh: 14.5 Scenario 4 — Risk Summary | 風險總結
blocks.en: 14.5 Scenario 4 — Risk Summary

blocks.zh: Scenario 4 的核心教訓
blocks.en: Core lessons of Scenario 4

blocks.zh: 矩陣法 + 分析方法改善：當最嚴格組合的清潔限度無法被偵測時，優先改善分析方法或重新界定矩陣邊界，而非直接放棄共用設施。
blocks.en: Matrix approach + analytical method improvement: when the cleaning limit of the most stringent combination cannot be detected, first improve the analytical method or redefine the matrix boundary, rather than abandoning the shared facility outright.

blocks.zh: 開放製程需要更嚴格的程序管控：無工程控制的設施，人員行為（著裝、清潔程序、物料管理）是風險的主要來源。
blocks.en: Open processing needs stricter procedural control: in a facility without engineering controls, personnel behavior (gowning, cleaning procedures, material management) is the main source of risk.

blocks.zh: 視覺清潔驗證的侷限性：對低 ADE 物質，視覺檢查遠不足夠，必須有化學分析支持。
blocks.en: The limits of visual cleaning verification: for substances with a low ADE, visual inspection is far from sufficient and must be backed by chemical analysis.

blocks.zh: 最差情況選擇需綜合考量：危害特性（ADE）僅是其中一個因子，製造頻率和接觸面積同等重要。
blocks.en: Worst-case selection needs an integrated view: hazard characteristics (ADE) are only one factor; manufacturing frequency and contact surface area are equally important.

blocks.zh: 14.6 Logic Diagram — Risk-Based Manufacturing & Sourcing Decisions | 風險基礎製造決策邏輯圖
blocks.en: 14.6 Logic Diagram — Risk-Based Manufacturing & Sourcing Decisions

blocks.zh: 邏輯圖的三大決策區塊
blocks.en: The three decision blocks of the logic diagram

blocks.zh: 本邏輯圖（Logic Diagram）是 ISPE Vol. 7 整個附錄 1 的核心工具，涵蓋三個決策維度：
blocks.en: The Logic Diagram is the core tool of the whole of ISPE Vol. 7 Appendix 1. It covers three decision dimensions:

blocks.zh: cGMP/法規焦點：是否有監管要求使用專屬設施？分析方法能否偵測清潔限度？
blocks.en: cGMP/regulatory focus: is there a regulatory requirement for a dedicated facility? Can the analytical method detect the cleaning limit?

blocks.zh: 健康與衛生焦點：患者和作業員的風險是否在可接受範圍？若否，是否可透過管控措施降低？
blocks.en: Health and hygiene focus: are the risks to patients and operators within an acceptable range? If not, can they be reduced through controls?

blocks.zh: 設施適應與風險管理：製程能否在現有設施中設計實施？管理框架是否完備？
blocks.en: Facility fit and risk management: can the process be designed and implemented in the existing facility? Is the management framework complete?

blocks.zh: 邏輯圖的實際應用方式
blocks.en: How the logic diagram is applied in practice

blocks.zh: 在實務中，邏輯圖不是線性步驟清單，而是一個迭代式決策框架：
blocks.en: In practice, the logic diagram is not a linear checklist but an iterative decision framework:

blocks.zh: 每個問題的答案可能觸發新的調查（如改善分析方法）
blocks.en: The answer to each question may trigger a new investigation (such as improving an analytical method)

blocks.zh: 管控措施實施後需要重新評估（如 DoE 後重新計算 Ppk）
blocks.en: After controls are implemented, re-assessment is needed (such as recalculating Ppk after DoE)

blocks.zh: 最終結論需要所有路徑均通過，才能宣告風險可接受
blocks.en: The final conclusion requires every path to pass before the risk can be declared acceptable

blocks.zh: 法規要求的「二元篩選」
blocks.en: The "binary screening" of regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 邏輯圖的最初兩個節點構成「法規篩選門檻」：
blocks.en: The first two nodes of the logic diagram form the "regulatory screening threshold":

blocks.zh: 是否有明確法規要求專屬設施？若是，直接需要專屬設施，無需進一步分析。
blocks.en: Is there an explicit regulatory requirement for a dedicated facility? If yes, a dedicated facility is needed directly and no further analysis is required.

blocks.zh: 分析方法能否偵測清潔限度？若否，EU GMP 3.6 不允許共用設施（直到方法改善）。
blocks.en: Can the analytical method detect the cleaning limit? If not, EU GMP 3.6 does not permit a shared facility (until the method is improved).

blocks.zh: 只有通過這兩個前提，才能進入風險分析階段。這也是 Scenario 4 初始「不合規」的根本原因，並驅動了整個分析方法改善工作。
blocks.en: Only when both preconditions are met can the risk analysis stage begin. This is also the root cause of the initial "non-compliance" in Scenario 4 and drove the whole analytical method improvement effort.

blocks.zh: 邏輯圖的設計哲學
blocks.en: Design philosophy of the logic diagram

blocks.zh: 此邏輯圖體現了 ICH Q9 的核心精神：風險管理是一個動態過程，而非一次性評估。每個問題節點都允許「若現在不可行，是否可以改善後再試？」的路徑，避免了過度保守（直接放棄）或過於冒進（忽視風險）兩個極端。
blocks.en: The logic diagram embodies the core spirit of ICH Q9: risk management is a dynamic process, not a one-time assessment. Every question node allows the path "if it is not feasible now, can it be improved and tried again?", which avoids both extremes of over-conservatism (giving up outright) and over-boldness (ignoring the risk).
